description: The verdict logic of the AI Triangle self-assessment, as data. This file is the single source of truth. The reference widget inlines an equivalent implementation, and tools/verify-bands.mjs proves the two agree across all 125 possible inputs.

axis.note: 1 = none, 5 = consistent practice. See assessment/SCORING.md for the mapping from the twelve-item paper instrument onto this axis.

evaluation: Rules are evaluated in order. The first rule whose condition holds wins. The order is load-bearing: allAtMost 3 is tested before the countBelow tests, so (3,3,3) is collapsing rather than uneven, and (2,3,3) is collapsing rather than tilting.
stability: The five verdict strings are a stability commitment. They cannot change without a major version. See framework/SPEC.md.

rules.verdict: The shape is collapsing. Pick one vertex to start with this week. CI of self is usually the right one.
Triangle is tilting. The artifact still looks polished. The maintenance is not happening.
Lopsided. The neglected vertex is the one to invest in next.
Uneven. Invest in the lowest vertex next.
